name: functional_medicine
description: Datenpaket für funktionelle Medizin: Mikronährstoffe, Hormone, Schilddrüse, Metabolik, Glukose (CGM), Schlaf, Stress, Symptomzeitachse, Ernährung
description_en: Data package for functional medicine: micronutrients, hormones, thyroid, metabolic markers, glucose (CGM), sleep, stress, symptom timeline, nutrition

queries.nutrient_hormone_labs: SELECT date, parameter, wert AS value, einheit AS unit, ref_min AS range_min, ref_max AS range_max, status, labor AS lab FROM lab_all WHERE person = :person AND parameter IN ('Vitamin D (25-OH)','Vitamin D 25-OH','Vitamin D3 (25-OH)','Vitamin B12','Holotranscobalamin','Folsäure','Vitamin-B6','Vitamin-C','Magnesium','Magnesium-i.E.','Zink','Selen','Kupfer','Eisen','Ferritin','Transferrin','Transferrinsättigung','Hämoglobin','MCV','MCH','MCHC','TSH','fT3','fT4','Anti-TPO','Anti-TG','rT3','Cortisol','DHEA-S','Testosteron gesamt','Testosteron frei','Östradiol','Progesteron','FSH','LH','SHBG','IGF-1','Insulin','HOMA-IR','HbA1c','Leptin','Adiponektin','Vitamin-D','25-OH-Vitamin-D','Vitamin-B12','Hb','Testosteron','freies-Testosteron') AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date, parameter
queries.metabolic_labs: SELECT date, parameter, wert AS value, einheit AS unit, ref_min AS range_min, ref_max AS range_max, status, labor AS lab FROM lab_all WHERE person = :person AND parameter IN ('Glucose','Glucose (nüchtern)','Glukose (NaF)','Nüchternblutzucker','HbA1c','Insulin','HOMA-IR','Triglyceride','HDL-Cholesterin','LDL-Cholesterin','Cholesterin gesamt','Cholesterin','Lipoprotein a','ApoB','GPT (ALAT)','GPT (ALT)','GOT (AST)','GOT (ASAT)','GGT','Bilirubin gesamt','Bilirubin direkt','Bilirubin indirekt','Kreatinin','Cystatin-C','eGFR (CKD-EPI)','GFR (CKD-EPI)','Harnsäure','Homocystein','hsCRP','CRP','Fibrinogen n. Clauss','D-Dimer','Glukose','Nüchternglukose','Triglyzeride','HDL','LDL','Gesamtcholesterin','Lp(a)','ALT','AST','Bilirubin','eGFR','Fibrinogen') AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date, parameter
queries.cgm_daily_summary: SELECT date, ROUND(AVG(glucose_mmol),2) as glucose_avg, ROUND(MIN(glucose_mmol),2) as glucose_min, ROUND(MAX(glucose_mmol),2) as glucose_max, COUNT(*) as n_readings FROM cgm_readings WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to GROUP BY date ORDER BY date
queries.sleep_detail: SELECT s.date, sm_total.value as total_sleep_min, sm_rem.value as rem_min, sm_deep.value as deep_min, sm_eff.value as sleep_efficiency_pct, sm_score.value as sleep_score, sm_latency.value as sleep_latency_min FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN session_metrics sm_total ON sm_total.session_id = s.id AND sm_total.metric = 'total_sleep_min' LEFT JOIN session_metrics sm_rem ON sm_rem.session_id = s.id AND sm_rem.metric = 'rem_min' LEFT JOIN session_metrics sm_deep ON sm_deep.session_id = s.id AND sm_deep.metric = 'deep_min' LEFT JOIN session_metrics sm_eff ON sm_eff.session_id = s.id AND sm_eff.metric = 'sleep_efficiency_pct' LEFT JOIN session_metrics sm_score ON sm_score.session_id = s.id AND sm_score.metric = 'sleep_score' LEFT JOIN session_metrics sm_latency ON sm_latency.session_id = s.id AND sm_latency.metric = 'sleep_latency_min' WHERE s.type = 'sleep' AND s.person = :person AND s.date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY s.date
queries.daily_stress_activity: SELECT date, person, steps, active_energy_kcal AS active_calories, sleep_hr_avg AS hr_avg, resting_hr_bpm AS hr_resting, hrv_rmssd_ms, ROUND(stress_high_s/60.0,1) AS stress_high_min, spo2_avg_pct AS spo2_avg, resp_rate_avg AS respiration_avg, readiness_score FROM daily_context WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.broad_symptoms: SELECT date, symptom, value_num, value_text, category FROM symptoms WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date, category
queries.assessments: SELECT date, instrument, score, details FROM assessments WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.blood_pressure_log: SELECT ts, date, systolic, diastolic, pulse, ihb_flag, notes, device_id FROM blood_pressure WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.orthostatic_tests: SELECT date, hr_supine, hr_stand_peak, hr_stand, hr_delta, rmssd_supine, rmssd_stand, rmssd_delta, source_app FROM orthostatic_test WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.medications_supplements: SELECT ts, date, drug_name, dose_value, dose_unit, route, notes FROM medications WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts

algorithm_note: CGM-Daten aus Freestyle Libre 3 (15-Minuten-Intervall, Consumer-Gerät). Hormon- und Mikronährstoffwerte sind aus lab_all (vereinigt lab_manual und PDF-Import) — Referenzbereiche gelten für Labormethode und ggf. Tageszeit der Blutabnahme. HRV-Werte sind Consumer-Wearable-Näherungen, keine klinischen Messwerte.
